readPrompts.template:
Explain the text below to someone new to the topic: what it is about, the terms it uses, who is involved and what happens next. Plain words and short paragraphs. Mark anything you are unsure of as unsure.

{selection}

readPrompts.name: Why does it matter?
readPrompts.template:
In three or four sentences, say why the text below matters to the reader, what decision or action it calls for, and by when, if it says. Use only what the text says.

{selection}

aiTemplate:
Write an executive summary of the differences between two versions of a report, for a busy manager: three to five sentences, then up to five bullets with what changed and what may need attention. Use only the facts below. Do not guess at reasons.

{selection}
